rules.description: Child must have been under 18 at time of death, or a stillbirth after 24 weeks of pregnancy
rules.reason_if_failed: This benefit is only available for children under 18 or stillbirths after 24 weeks of pregnancy

rules.description: Leave or pay must be taken/claimed within 56 weeks of the date of death or stillbirth
rules.reason_if_failed: You must claim within 56 weeks of the date of death or stillbirth

rules.description: Applicant must be the child's parent, parent's partner, or had day-to-day responsibility for the child
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be the child's parent, the partner of the parent, or have had day-to-day responsibility for the child

rules.description: Applicant must be classed as an employee (for leave entitlement)
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be an employee to qualify for Parental Bereavement Leave

rules.description: For pay, applicant must have been continuously employed for at least 26 weeks up to the end of the relevant week
rules.reason_if_failed: You must have been employed for at least 26 weeks to qualify for Statutory Parental Bereavement Pay (you may still be eligible for leave)

rules.description: For pay, applicant must earn on average £125 per week before tax
rules.reason_if_failed: You must earn at least £125 per week on average to qualify for Statutory Parental Bereavement Pay (you may still be eligible for leave)

rules.description: For pay, applicant must be employed on the day of death or stillbirth
rules.reason_if_failed: You must have been employed on the day of the death or stillbirth to qualify for pay

rules.description: Applicant must give employer correct notice for leave (varies by timing)
rules.reason_if_failed: You must give your employer the required notice before taking leave

rules.description: For pay, applicant must claim within 28 days of the first day of the week being claimed for
rules.reason_if_failed: You must claim Statutory Parental Bereavement Pay within 28 days of the first day of the week you're claiming for

explanation_template: Statutory Parental Bereavement eligibility: {outcome}. Leave eligibility: {leave_eligible}. Pay eligibility: {pay_eligible}.

edge_cases.description: For day-to-day carers, child must have lived with applicant for 4 continuous weeks before death
edge_cases.action: Verify that child lived with applicant for 4 continuous weeks ending with date of death, and applicant/partner had day-to-day care responsibility. If paid to look after child, only eligible if foster parent with local authority fee/allowance.

edge_cases.description: Paid carers are generally not eligible unless foster parent or receiving expense reimbursement
edge_cases.action: Check if applicant is: (1) foster parent with local authority fee/allowance, (2) reimbursed for expenses only, or (3) receiving payments under will/trust. Otherwise, not eligible.

edge_cases.description: Adoptive parents eligible after order granted, or before if placement not disrupted
edge_cases.action: Verify adoption order granted or that child was placed and placement was not disrupted/stopped. If international adoption, verify 'official notification' received and child entered UK.

edge_cases.description: Biological parents not eligible after adoption/parental order unless contact order in place
edge_cases.action: Check if contact order was in place. If not, not eligible. Route to bereavement support services.

edge_cases.description: Parents via surrogate eligible after parental order made, or before if applied/intended within 6 months
edge_cases.action: Verify parental order granted OR that applicant applied/intended to apply within 6 months of birth and expected order to be granted.

edge_cases.description: If taking other statutory leave (maternity, paternity, shared parental), Parental Bereavement Leave must start after that leave ends
edge_cases.action: Confirm dates of other statutory leave. Parental Bereavement Leave must start after other leave ends, but still within 56 weeks of death/stillbirth. Provide guidance on booking leave after other leave period.

edge_cases.description: Stillbirths before 24 weeks of pregnancy are not covered by this scheme
edge_cases.action: Not eligible for this scheme. Route to employer's own bereavement policy and external bereavement support services.

edge_cases.description: Day-to-day carer not eligible if child's parent or someone with parental responsibility lived in same household
edge_cases.action: Not eligible as a day-to-day carer if parent or person with parental responsibility also lived in household. Check if eligible under different relationship type.
